title: Set 324

sentences.ko: 통화만 하면 화면이 까맣게 꺼지고 다시 안 켜져서, 자꾸 얼굴로 전화를 끊어 버려. 폰 케이스 때문인 줄 알았는데, 케이스를 빼도 계속 그래.
sentences.text: Every time I'm on a call, the screen goes black and won't come back on, so I keep hanging up on people with my face. I thought it was my phone case, but I took it off and it's still doing it.

alts.text: Whenever I'm on the phone my screen just goes black and stays off, so I keep hanging up on people with my cheek. Figured it was the case, but nope, took it off and it's still happening.

Whenever I am on a call, the screen turns black and does not come back on, so I keep accidentally hanging up on people with my face. I assumed the phone case was the cause, but I removed it and the problem persists.

sentences.note: **hang up on people** 은 통화하던 상대의 전화를 끊어 버린다는 말입니다. 화면이 꺼질 때는 **goes black** 이라고 하고, casual 의 **Figured** 는 I figured 를 줄인 말로 ~인 줄 알았다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 남동생이 또 돈을 빌려 달래. 안 된다고 하면 몇 달은 나한테 서운해할 거 뻔해. 근데 지난번에 빌려준 돈은 다시는 구경도 못 했거든. 모르겠다. 너라면 어떻게 할 거야?
sentences.text: So my brother wants to borrow money again, and I know if I say no he's gonna be upset with me for months. But the last time I lent him money, I never saw it again. I don't know. What would you do?

alts.text: Ugh, my brother's asking to borrow money again, and if I say no he'll be mad at me for months. But last time I lent him some, I never got it back. I dunno. What would you do?

My brother would like to borrow money again, and I know that if I refuse, he will be upset with me for months. However, the last time I lent him money, it was never repaid. I am not sure what to do. What would you do in my position?

sentences.note: **I never saw it again** 은 빌려준 돈을 다시는 구경도 못 했다는 말입니다. **be upset with me** 는 나한테 화나 있다, 서운해한다는 뜻이고, 몇 달씩 갈 때는 for months 를 붙입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 그래, 네가 거기를 왜 그렇게 좋아하는지 완전 알겠어. 근데 현금만 받는다는 말은 안 해 줬잖아. 그래서 다들 나 기다리는 동안 저 아래 ATM까지 뛰어갔다 와야 했어.
sentences.text: Okay, I totally get why you love that place. But you didn't tell me it was cash only, so I had to run to an ATM down the street while everybody waited for me.

alts.text: Yeah, I get it now, that place is great. But you never said it was cash only, so I had to run down the street to an ATM with everyone waiting on me.
I completely understand why you are so fond of that restaurant. However, you did not mention that it only accepted cash, so I had to go to an ATM down the street while everyone waited for me.

sentences.note: **I totally get why** 는 왜 그런지 완전 이해된다는 말입니다. 가게가 현금만 받을 때는 **cash only** 라고 합니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 우리 상사는 연휴만 지나면 나아질 거라고 계속 그러는데, 작년에도 똑같은 소리 했거든. 다른 데 정해 둔 데가 있었으면 아마 벌써 나갔을 거야.
sentences.text: My boss keeps saying things are gonna get better after the holidays, but he said that last year too. If I had something else lined up, I think I'd already be gone.

alts.text: Apparently it's all gonna get better after the holidays. That's what my boss said last year too. If I had another job lined up, I'd be outta here already.
My manager continues to say that things will improve after the holidays, but he said the same thing last year. If I had another position arranged, I believe I would have already left.

sentences.note: **lined up** 은 다음 일자리처럼 미리 정해 둔 것이 있다는 말입니다. **I'd already be gone** 은 벌써 그만두고 나갔을 거라는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 차 타고 할아버지 뵈러 갔어. 처음에는 내가 누군지 잘 못 알아보셨는데, 옛날 사진을 좀 보여 드렸더니 나중에는 내가 한 번도 못 들어 본 얘기를 해 주시더라.
sentences.text: We drove up to see my grandfather on Saturday. He didn't really know who I was at first, but then I showed him some old pictures, and by the end he was telling me stories I'd never heard before.

alts.text: Went up to see my grandpa Saturday. He didn't recognize me at first, but I showed him some old photos and by the end he was telling me stories I'd never heard.
We drove up to visit my grandfather on Saturday. At first he did not quite recognize me, but after I showed him some old photographs, by the end he was sharing stories I had never heard before.

sentences.note: **drove up to see** 는 차를 몰고 누구를 보러 갔다는 말입니다. **by the end** 는 끝 무렵에는, 나중에는 이라는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 1번 formal: the problem continues 는 어색해서 the problem persists 로 고침
3번 casual: I totally get/see why 로 시작이 text 와 겹쳐서 더 짧은 구어로 새로 씀
4번 casual: My boss keeps 로 시작이 text 와 겹치고, Honestly 는 뜻 없이 붙인 말버릇이라 빼고 새로 씀
5번 casual: kinda didn't know 는 원어민이 잘 안 쓰는 어순이라 He didn't recognize me at first 로 고침
5번 formal: he was telling me stories by the end that I had never heard 는 어순이 꼬여 읽기 힘들어서 by the end 를 앞으로 옮김
